title: Exact preframed callback source and keyless inherited Object prefix state

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the executed single-owner preframed-source and existing Inline regression scope
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; actual Compact JSON reader, remaining all-types/MV/projection support and later <=10% speed qualification remain open
claim.meaning: Curated index to root-observed evidence. Packet shape, hashes and correlated Luna review do not prove the behavioral claims.

risk.boundary: Object callback parser lifecycle, inherited statistics context, keyless retained prefixes and generalized body-consumer owner identity
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic prerequisite commit over the baseline; no push or history rewrite

admitted: Self-delimited parsing borrows one already-framed named event and commits only successful exact consumption; wrong names, parser failure and partial/negative/oversized consumption do not commit.
One source parser reservation rejects nested parser, legacy take and fixed take_exact reads before event consumption; a rejected inner call cannot release the outer reservation.
Empty events remain explicit and fixed discriminator/LowCardinality prefix callbacks require their exact extent.
Independent literal Object V3 and inferred Dynamic V3 prefixes exercise complete statistics, descriptor-relative depth and retained statistics offsets without consuming a following event.
A keyless static prefix reuses the same Object/Dynamic traversal without a fabricated Dynamic JSON leaf key or Wide registry.
Existing Inline lifecycle guards and registry-backed four-argument advanced decoding remain supported.
Capture, advanced decoder and materializer require their retained exact physical-plan instance before plan/grid/body access; matching canonical roots do not admit another owner.
The caller-owned event-capture node budget is preflighted and charged before source consumption, without double-charging the appended owner node.

Complete static body materialization is not GREEN: generalized signatures and owner guards do not resolve prefix-only Object/Dynamic statistics offset checks.
No native Compact JSON reader or public/typed/offline guard is admitted; three native roots and the full 48-cell matrix remain pending.
No native ordinary Dynamic JSON-arm witness is established by the current 48-cell baseline or these literal/local tests.

Parser budgets and metadata are not rolled back. Older TapeReader slice/LowCardinality failures can consume an event before their own budget failure; discard failed enclosing operations instead of assuming retryability.
Internal schedules/prefix arrays are mutable references, not language-enforced immutable or linear ownership.
Parser reservation is single-owner discipline, not thread synchronization or general concurrency safety.
The writer-backed recursive regression examples are not an independent native serializer compatibility oracle.
No allocator/RSS, lazy-access, cross-part aggregate caching, speed, Compact writing or global-goal completion is claimed.
